description: Only in a build with downloads (the `downloads` Cargo feature, ATLAS_ENABLE_DOWNLOADS=1): the main window's commands for downloading map images and their settings, for downloading the location photos a pack lists to be fetched later, for measuring which map images of an imported map exist, for reading pages for an importer that fetches them, and for viewing a map page and saving its images as the person browses. No other window is granted anything.
